work.author: SANCTISSIMI DOMINI NOSTRI PII DIVINA PROVIDENTIA PAPAE II.
work.description: The act approves Clement Bahus as Melkite patriarch. Issuer evidence: SANCTISSIMI DOMINI NOSTRI PII DIVINA PROVIDENTIA PAPAE II. at LF29962-29964. Dating LF29968-29968 reads: HABITA IN CONSISTORIO SRCRBTO DIE XVI IVNI1 ANNO MDCCGLVt Date note: Edition dated caption Habita in consistorio ..., retained in the selection; it is the only printed dating of the speech. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
